## Workload

Lena Fischer graded 434 sets during 348 rostered hours. This represents an average output of 1.2 per hour across the review period. The workload was completed within the allocated hours, with grading activity maintained consistently throughout. The volume of work provides the basis for assessing both productivity and the quality of decisions recorded.

## Quality

A sample of 26 sets was read again as part of the quality review. Agreement was 73.1 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent interpretation and decision-making. The findings should be considered alongside the workload completed and the issues identified through the sample review.

The work was reviewed by Priya Anand.
